raw_response:
This small plot is where I grow my cassava close to the house, so I can keep watch over it. I do not have much money for chemical fertilizer on this piece — I mostly put the household waste and goat droppings there to keep the soil strong. I use cuttings from my sister who got improved stems from the extension officer last year, and the rains here are enough, so I do not need to water it. I will do most of the weeding and harvesting myself with help from my daughter, but I will pay two young men for a day to help me clear and make the ridges at the start.
